_deprecated: DEPRECATED. Replaced by tokens.json at the repo root, and by snippets/palette.css for CSS. Still served for anything already pointing at it. Do not add a color here. The role strings below predate house type system v1.0 and overstate what #B77808 can do: measured on #FFFFFF it is 3.68:1, which permits 18pt print or 24px web and up, the .bk-h3 step and above, and nothing smaller. See reference/brand.md for the measured contrast table.

apexBlue.role: Primary brand color, logo wordmark, headers, links, buttons, primary accents

apexBlueDeep.role: Hero backgrounds, full-width header bands, section dividers, footers

apexBlueLight.role: Tertiary accents, hover states, lighter highlights

apexGold.role: Signature accent, the arc, accent bars, kickers, stat numerals, highlights

apexGoldDeep.role: Gold text on white at 3.68:1. 18pt print or 24px web and up, the .bk-h3 step and above, and icons. Never small text. Bright gold #FDB61C is 1.77:1 and is never text on white

black.role: Body text, high-contrast headings on light backgrounds

white.role: Text on dark backgrounds, page background

surface.role: Very-light indigo background tint for alternating rows / callouts
